project_type: Monorepo with React Native (Expo) mobile app and React (Vite) web app
build_system: Bun for web, Expo CLI for mobile. Root uses bun workspaces.
test_framework: Vitest for web (vitest.config.js). No test files found but vitest configured.
test_command: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform android
verification_instructions: 1. Web: cd apps/web && bun run build (exit 0). 2. Mobile: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform android (exit 0). 3. Web lint: cd apps/web && bun run lint (exit 0).
setup_instructions: 1. cd apps/web && bun install. 2. cd apps/mobile && bun install.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Bun 1.2.14 available. Node 22 available via nvm.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns (JSX, no TypeScript enforcement, Tailwind for web, StyleSheet for mobile).
key_patterns: Mobile: Expo Router with (tabs)/_layout.jsx defining bottom tabs, theme.js for centralized styling, api.js for data fetching with cache layer, language.js for locale management using AsyncStorage. Web: React Router with Layout.jsx wrapping all routes, Tailwind CSS with custom theme in tailwind.config.js, utils/api.js for data fetching, utils/language.js for locale with localStorage. Both apps use @tanstack/react-query for server state. Tab components use TabBar (mobile) and TabNavigation (web) pattern. Content displayed via ContentRail (horizontal scroll) and ContentGrid (grid layout).
directory_structure: apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/ - tab screens (home, movies, tv, anime, search). apps/mobile/src/components/ - shared mobile components. apps/mobile/src/utils/ - api, cache, language, storage, player utilities. apps/web/src/app/ - page components (Home, Movies, TV, Search, etc). apps/web/src/components/ - shared web components. apps/web/src/utils/ - api, cache, language, storage, player utilities. apps/web/src/lib/ - utility functions (cn).
